# Joko Widodo, 2024, 1B.1 Research Note

Assessment: the 2024 record I found supports a **risk-reduction / de-escalation** reading. I found concrete evidence of anti-nuclear disarmament activity and repeated calls for restraint and dialogue. I did **not** find credible 2024 evidence that Widodo pursued nuclear escalation or other existential-risk escalation for prestige, leverage, or personal power.

## Accepted claims

| Valence | Title | Publisher / date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Favorable | [President Jokowi Strongly Opposes PM Netanyahu’s Statement on Palestinian Statehood](https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-strongly-opposes-pm-netanyahus-statement-on-palestinian-statehood/) | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-01-26 | https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-strongly-opposes-pm-netanyahus-statement-on-palestinian-statehood/ | Jokowi publicly rejected Netanyahu’s statement against a two-state solution, condemned Israeli attacks on Khan Younis, and instructed Indonesia’s foreign minister to keep voicing support for the Palestinian cause. This is a direct restraint / conflict-de-escalation signal rather than escalation. | `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia discusses nuclear test ban treaty ratification with CTBTO](https://en.antaranews.com/news/316995/indonesia-discusses-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-ratification-with-ctbto) | ANTARA News, 2024-06-26 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/316995/indonesia-discusses-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-ratification-with-ctbto | Indonesia’s foreign minister met the CTBTO to advance CTBT ratification, explicitly framing this in the context of a world increasingly exposed to conflict and uncertainty. This is strong evidence of nuclear-risk reduction behavior in Jokowi’s final year. | `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia calls for firm ASEAN stance on nuclear disarmament](https://en.antaranews.com/news/319647/indonesia-calls-for-firm-asean-stance-on-nuclear-disarmament) | ANTARA News, 2024-07-24 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/319647/indonesia-calls-for-firm-asean-stance-on-nuclear-disarmament | Indonesia called on ASEAN to strengthen nuclear disarmament efforts and warned that retreat by nuclear-armed states from international agreements pushes the world farther from a nuclear-free outcome. This directly supports a pro-disarmament, anti-escalation posture. | `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia joins countries prohibiting nuclear weapons](https://en.antaranews.com/news/327307/indonesia-joins-countries-prohibiting-nuclear-weapons) | ANTARA News, 2024-09-25 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/327307/indonesia-joins-countries-prohibiting-nuclear-weapons | Indonesia formally submitted its ratification instrument for the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons at the UN in New York on 24 Sep 2024. That is the clearest 2024 action reducing nuclear risk. | `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Presiden Jokowi Tegaskan Dialog Adalah Solusi Terbaik untuk Konflik di Timur Tengah](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-tengah/) | Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia, 2024-10-05 | https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-tengah/ | Jokowi said dialogue is the best way to reduce escalation in the Middle East and urged all parties to restrain themselves. While not nuclear-specific, it is direct evidence of general de-escalation preference. | `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia Condemns Israeli Attacks on Gaza, Lebanon, UN Peacekeepers](https://setkab.go.id/en/indonesia-condemns-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-lebanon-un-peacekeepers/) | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-10-15 | https://setkab.go.id/en/indonesia-condemns-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-lebanon-un-peacekeepers/ | Jokowi condemned attacks on civilians and UN peacekeepers and called for restraint and an end to armed conflict. This is another explicit anti-escalation statement. | `1B.1` |

## Search gap

I did **not** find credible 2024 evidence of the opposite behavior for this lens, meaning:
- no report that Widodo pursued nuclear brinkmanship,
- no report that he sought prestige or leverage through nuclear escalation,
- no report that he used existential-risk escalation as a personal power tool.

That absence is meaningful here because Indonesia is not a nuclear-armed state, so the relevant 2024 record is mainly treaty, diplomacy, and restraint behavior rather than weapons signaling. The best-supported conclusion from the sources I found is that Widodo’s 2024 behavior on this lens was **risk-reducing, not escalation-seeking**.
